name: group bond
quote: He's a big fan of the baseball team.
description: Positive feelings about others that share in a particular social structure.

variations.name: team spirit
variations.description: Positive feelings towards your group in a friendly competition with other teams.
examples: I think we did well in the hackathon, but some of the other teams were pretty good too.

variations.name: tribalism
variations.description: Positive feelings towards your group along with negative feelings towards competing groups.
examples: The sports fans started fighting after the match.

variations.name: spiritual bond
variations.description: A sense that you are on a path of existential meaning with others.

commentaries.quote: A small group of friends has a very different feeling from a large online movement, but our brains revel in the interactions of the social environment. We enjoy big bombastic social sensations and the deliciously subtle.
We love belonging to social structures because they provide identity, community, and purpose. You may want to be cautious about joining groups that are bonded by a dislike for other groups.
The human ability to join into groups is one or our superpowers. Well-organized groups can do things that would be impossible alone, from building pyramids to spaceflight.

conditions: Positive feelings about others that share in a particular social structure.
